slide1.headline: AI Startup Raises $320 Million
slide1.subtitle: General Intuition Secures Funding from Top Investors

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: AI startup General Intuition raised $320 million from Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Jeff Bezos.
The funding round was announced on 26 Jun 2026.
General Intuition plans to use the funds to expand its AI services.
The company has not disclosed its valuation.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding round is one of the largest for an AI startup in recent months.
It highlights the growing interest in AI technology from top investors.
General Intuition's AI services have the potential to disrupt various industries.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: General Intuition's funding round is a significant milestone for the AI industry.
The company's AI services have the potential to drive innovation and growth.
The funding round is a testament to the growing demand for AI technology.

slide1.headline: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Custom AI Inference Chip
slide1.subtitle: Target Deployment by End-2026

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: OpenAI and Broadcom unveiled a custom AI inference chip on 24 Jun 2026.
The chip was developed in a nine-month cycle.
The companies plan to deploy the chip by the end of 2026.
The chip has the potential to improve AI performance and efficiency.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The development of the custom AI inference chip is a significant milestone for OpenAI and Broadcom.
The chip has the potential to drive innovation and growth in the AI industry.
The deployment of the chip by the end of 2026 is a testament to the companies' commitment to AI technology.

lines: Google has called for AI regulation on its own terms.
The company wants a balanced approach to AI regulation.

The company has proposed a framework for AI regulation.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: Google's call for AI regulation on its own terms highlights the need for a balanced approach.
The company's proposed framework for AI regulation could drive innovation and growth in the industry.
